mapper.select: SELECT s.subscription_no AS subscription_no, s.member_no AS member_no, s.product_no AS product_no, s.account_no AS account_no, s.subscription_amount AS subscription_amount, s.applied_interest_rate AS applied_interest_rate, s.subscribed_at AS subscribed_at, s.maturity_date AS maturity_date, s.subscription_status AS subscription_status, p.product_name AS product_name, p.product_type AS product_type FROM tb_product_sales s JOIN tb_product p ON s.product_no = p.product_no JOIN TB_BANK_MEMBER M ON S.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE M.LOGIN_ID = #{username} ORDER BY s.subscribed_at DESC
